eyebrow.zh: 运行时锻造 · 测试把关 · 本地签名

headline.zh:
你的 agent 装了上千 skill
还是会撞上没覆盖的任务
headline.en:
Your agent has a thousand skills
and still hits a task none cover

sub.zh: capforge 观察任务、当场锻造一个新 skill，测试它、签名它、打上来源标签，然后一键装进你的 skill 库。
sub.en: capforge observes the task, forges a new Skill on the spot, tests it, signs it, and provenance-tags it — then promotes it into your library.

title.zh: 撞上没覆盖的任务？当场锻造一个
title.en: Hits a task nothing covers? Forge one on the spot

body.zh: 不用等别人写好、也不用自己手写——给个任务描述，capforge 调你的模型合成一个新 skill，几秒就到手。
body.en: No waiting for someone to curate it, no writing it by hand — give capforge the task and it calls your model to synthesize a new Skill in seconds.

title.zh: 没通过测试的 skill，绝不签名
title.en: Never signs a skill that fails its own test

body.zh: 每条样例都在沙箱里跑一遍；通不过断言的 skill 不会被签名——验证时直接报签名无效。
body.en: Every example runs in a throwaway sandbox with a timeout; a skill that fails its own assertion is never signed — verify reports it as invalid.

title.zh: 签名覆盖整条记录，改一个字就露馅
title.en: Signature covers the whole record — one edit and it shows

body.zh: 签名不只盖住 skill 文本，连测试、来源、合成模型一并覆盖；分享出去的 skill 谁也篡改不了来源。
body.en: The signature commits to the skill text AND the full record — test, origin, how it was made — so a shared skill's provenance can't be silently rewritten.

title.zh: 完全本地，自带密钥，不建账号
title.en: Fully local, your own key, no account

body.zh: 一个二进制、一把本地密钥、用你自己的 API key——不联网、不多用户、不需要登录，锻造完一键装进你的 agent。
body.en: One binary, a local keypair, your own API key — no network, no multi-user, no sign-up. Promote a signed skill into your agent with one click.

headline.zh: 让 agent 自己补上它缺的那块
headline.en: Let your agent forge the skill it's missing

sub.zh: 开源、本地、自带密钥。一条命令开始锻造。
sub.en: Open source, local, your own key. One command to start forging.

tag.zh: 运行时锻造 agent 技能
tag.en: Just-in-time capability forge for agentic coding agents
